### Crescent Energy Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results


November 2, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/856702509/files/doc_news/2026/Nov/02/Crescent-Energy-Reports-Third-Quarter-2026-Results.pdf)


HOUSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Crescent Energy Company (NYSE: CRGY) (“Crescent” or the “Company”) today announced financial and operating results for the third quarter of 2026. Crescent’s earnings release and supplemental earnings presentation can be found at[www.crescentenergyco.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcrescentenergyco.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54633162&newsitemid=20261102573823&lan=en-US&anchor=www.crescentenergyco.com&index=1&md5=4c411505bcbc139c6fcd348e79c71830) .


The Company’s third quarter 2026 conference call is planned for 10 a.m. CT (11 a.m. ET) on Tuesday, November 3, 2026.


**About Crescent Energy** **Company**


Crescent is a differentiated energy company committed to delivering value through a disciplined, returns-driven growth through acquisition strategy and consistent return of capital. Our long-life, balanced portfolio combines significant cash flow from stable production with deep, high-quality development inventory. Our activities are focused in the Eagle Ford, Permian and Uinta Basins, and we own minerals and royalty interests across premier U.S. oil and natural gas basins, primarily operated by large, well-capitalized companies, with a core focus in the Eagle Ford. For additional information, please visit[www.crescentenergyco.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcrescentenergyco.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54633162&newsitemid=20261102573823&lan=en-US&anchor=www.crescentenergyco.com&index=2&md5=412bc7c1decc22233443e22a09afb85c) .
